content.text:
I read every input file and every draft section, then built a full source ledger before deciding. Here is the outcome.

**What I traced**

- **Claims 1–17:** every limitation of the three independent claims (1 apparatus, 11 installed assembly, 14 method) and all fourteen dependent claims maps to an affirmative passage in `input/disclosure.md` — three carriages in radial guides, pivoting concave pads, the segmented ring in an annular guide with one segment per half, the hinge-end and latch-end complementary drive faces, followers in oblique slots, the wedge/ring drive face, the force-limiting spring stack between handle and wedge, the two latch positions, the indicator pin against the fixed edge, the carriage springs, and the mounting boss (including its negative "does not participate in jaw synchronization" limitation).
- **Numerals 10–66:** all 28 entries are used in the description, none carries two meanings, none appears in a figure brief without being in the ledger, and each appears on at least one sheet.
- **Segment/end correspondence:** 32 = upper = first frame half; 44/46 at the left (hinge) junction; 48/50 at the right (latch) junction — consistent across FIG. 1, FIG. 3 and FIG. 4, including FIG. 4's rotation of the FIG. 1 latch orientation.
- **Figure briefs:** the geometry choices I checked for substance — drive-face circumferential position at the latch end, slot rotational sense, carriage/pad contact topology, boss radially outboard of the annular guide, spring reaction against the frame, spring stack between handle and wedge — each trace to disclosed function rather than to a renderer's invention. The wedge is drawn as a plain block and the segment end faces as "matching outline", which avoids untraced taper/angle assertions.
- **Application text:** no "by way of example", "any closed outline", or other shape-justifying language leaks out of the figure briefs into §07 or §08; no drafting notes, placeholders, or open questions remain. The drafting agent's stray "self-adhering layer with a microsuction surface" claim in `conversation.md` does **not** appear anywhere in the draft.

I found no untraced technical assertion and no verified internal inconsistency, so the findings array is empty. Two notes outside my scope: I did not assess prior art or patentability, and no prior-art files were provided to me for the Background characterizations — a later review traces those.

input.summary: Full source-fidelity preflight completed against input/disclosure.md and the single USER passage in input/conversation.md, with input/brief.md used only for formalities (title, applicant/inventor, no priority claim, no government support). I built a complete ledger and traced every claim limitation, every numbered part, every figure-brief geometry statement, and every specific relationship, result, position, connection, operating condition and variant in the description; the complete claims, numerals/numbered parts, figure briefs and drawing descriptions, and affirmative inventor sources were all checked and traced, and no unsupported technical assertion or verified internal inconsistency was found. Claims: all limitations of independent claims 1, 11 and 14 and of dependent claims 2-10, 12-13 and 15-17 trace to affirmative disclosure text - three radial jaw carriages in radial guides, pivoting concave jaw pads with no tool-specific pipe diameter, segmented cam ring in an annular guide with one segment carried by each frame half, complementary drive faces at the hinge and latch ends coupling the segments on closure, followers in respective oblique slots, wedge driven against a drive face of the cam ring through a limited stroke, synchronized inward travel, outward-biasing carriage springs, the first holding position and second over-center position, the force-limiting spring stack between latch handle and wedge absorbing remaining travel, the indicator pin moving relative to a fixed edge of the latch housing at a predetermined compression range with the express negative that it does not measure pipe diameter, and the optional mounting boss outside the annular guide for a sensor, tool or conduit that does not participate in jaw synchronization. The installed-assembly and method classes are supported by the disclosed clamp-on-pipe arrangement and the disclosed install/remove sequences. Numerals: all 28 entries (10-66, with 28 unused) appear in the description, each designates exactly one part, no figure brief cites a numeral absent from the ledger, and every ledger numeral appears on at least one sheet. Frontmatter numeral lists match the trailing "Numerals shown on this figure" lists on all five sheets, and every placement target is drawn on its own sheet. Cross-figure geometry is coherent: 12 upper half / 14 lower half, hinge at the left break, latch at the right break, carriages at top, lower left and lower right at roughly 120 degrees clear of both breaks, and FIG. 3 correspondingly places 32 on the upper segment, 34 on the lower, 44/46 at the left (hinge) junction and 48/50 at the right (latch) junction; FIG. 4 is rotated 90 degrees from FIG. 1, which reconciles the FIG. 1 lever running outward and down-right with the FIG. 4 handle running up and to the right. Functional-surface geometry was checked under the stricter standard: the circumferential position of ring drive face 54 near the latch-end junction follows necessarily from the disclosed wedge being carried in the latch drive path at the latch end; the common rotational sense of the three oblique slots follows from the disclosed synchronized inward travel of all three carriages; the jaw pad, not the carriage, contacting the pipe follows from the disclosed pad that bears on the pipe; the boss radially outboard of the channel follows from "outside the annular guide". No untraced taper, angle, runout, depth, seal or flow statement appears - the wedge is deliberately drawn as a plain block and the segment end faces only as "faces of matching outline", both marked schematic, so no undisclosed relationship is verbalized. Text checks: claims and description use the same terms and relationships (force-limiting spring stack, ring drive face, over-center position, carriage spring, radial guide, annular guide); antecedent basis is sound, including "a pipe" introduced in claims 2, 9, 10 and the carriage spring introduced in claim 16; the abstract is roughly 139 words with no numerals; sections 02 and 03 correctly read "Not applicable" per the brief; and no drafting note, placeholder, open question, instruction, unresolved alternative or internal comment remains. Nothing in the application text or Brief Description adds "by way of example", "any closed outline" or similar language to justify a renderer's visual choice - the only view conventions ("near-side frame structure omitted", "cutaway") stay within ordinary partial-view practice and the claims and description remain shape-neutral. The drafting agent's turn in conversation.md asserts a "self-adhering layer with a microsuction surface" that has no basis in the disclosure; I confirmed that phrase and any such feature are absent from the title, summary, description, claims, abstract, numeral ledger and all five figure briefs, so no correction is required. Two scope notes: per instruction I did not inspect rendered images, and I did not assess patentability, novelty or prior art - no prior_art/ files were included in the material given to me, so the Background characterizations are left for the later citation review.
